observations.evidence_summary: Local Chrome rendered the page and the expanded Law 232/2022 offences table. Article 27(1)(f) maps breach of Article 13(1) to RON 6,000–12,000; (g) maps Article 13(2)(a)–(d) to RON 7,000–15,000; (h) maps Article 13(3) to RON 6,000–12,000; (i) maps Article 13(2)(e) to RON 7,000–15,000; (j) maps Article 13(2)(f)–(g) to RON 5,000–10,000. These rows concern service providers and cite Article 27(2) for measures. This establishes EAA-related statutory-sanctions guidance on the page, not an imposed fine, full sector-by-sector jurisdiction or a reporting destination. The table label Notificare: nu is not interpreted as removing service-provider notification duties.

observations.evidence_summary: The requested notice rendered in English without the previous TodayOJ redirect. OJ C/2026/2861, published 8 June 2026, reproduces the operative part of the 19 March 2026 judgment in C-646/24. It orders the Republic of Bulgaria to pay the Commission a EUR 1,500,000 lump sum for failure to transpose/notify Directive 2019/882, plus costs. This corroborates the recorded Member-State case; it is not a national business fine or proof of payment.

observations.evidence_summary: The exact EN-interface URL is readable. EUR-Lex explicitly says the document is unavailable in the interface language and displays the French judgment; its available HTML languages are Bulgarian and French. C-646/24, 19 March 2026, ECLI:EU:C:2026:221: paragraph 31 records withdrawal of the periodic-penalty request; paragraph 123 records complete transposition on 11 April 2025 and 1,017 days of failure; paragraph 127 and operative point 2 impose EUR 1,500,000 on the Republic of Bulgaria. This corroborates the earlier French InfoCuria reading, not a new business sanction. Payment remains unverified.
